title: Removing the File Extension Strips Every Dot
description:
`remove_extension(filename)` should strip only the final file extension from a filename. Right now it removes every dot in the name, even from filenames with multiple dots. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Function signature**
`remove_extension(filename: str) -> str`

**Example**
`remove_extension("report.v2.final.pdf")` -> `"report.v2.final"`.
